Recruitment Consultant
We understand that recruitment is a career that demands much of us and, whilst returns can be high, maximum ROI is necessary for individuals in order to realise the vision they have created for their personal lives. The rising cost of Sydney living only makes that more important.

Our consistent profitability, and the sustainability created through our recent M&A activities enable us to invest in growth without requiring instant results. We want to evolve EBC to a significant executive recruitment brand across Asia Pac – as part of that, we will hire additional talent and build brands around those people to ensure our future.

Simply put our agile, entrepreneurial, high on care/low on micro environment allows ambitious people to come and learn how to set up their own business. With our brand, environment and peer group we believe you’ll find a place that’s not just hard to leave but easy to stay.

Whilst average recruitment experience across the floor sits at 8 years per person, we aren’t fixed on that experience level, in fact, we are very open to talking with you if you’re relatively new to the game but can demonstrate proven recruitment billings success and you’re on the right trajectory.

The areas we are looking to grow include:
Accounting and Finance 
IT Infrastructure & Security
IT Data and Analytics
IT Development
IT Sales
Risk, compliance & Legal
Projects and Transformation
If you specialise in any of the above areas and like what you’ve read so far, we’d love to hear from you.

Ethos BeathChapman are one of the leading Executive Recruitment brands in Asia Pacific with presence in Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong and Japan, for more on us, visit www.ethosbc.com.au 

For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Andrew Keayes on 02 8227 9200 or apply directly via the Apply for this job button. Only WORD FORMAT resumes will be accepted.

Location: Slacks Creek QLD 

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Business:

Queensland Collision Centre Pty Ltd is a trusted automotive repair specialist based in Slacks Creek, Queensland, delivering high-quality smash repairs, panel beating, and vehicle spray painting services for both cars and trucks. The business has built a strong reputation for providing reliable, efficient, and cost-effective repair solutions tailored to each client’s needs.

About the Role:

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Panel Beater and Vehicle Spray Painter to join our team on a full-time basis.

Panel Beater

•	Qualification in Automotive Body Repair Technology or minimum 3 years relevant work experience

•	Disassemble and reassemble vehicle components as required

•	Perform panel beating and related auto body repairs to a high standard

•	Ensure all repair work meets industry regulations and safety standards

•	High attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills

•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team

•	Must have unrestricted availability to work full-time in Australia

Vehicle Spray Painter

Skills and experience required:

•	Trade qualified Vehicle Spray Painter or minimum 3 years relevant work experience

Attend pre-start meeting before commencement of work to discuss scheduled tasks, safety and/or work related issues.

Blast the surface of steel structures, pipelines, boilers, columns, I-beams, trusses and other related areas prior to commencing paint work.
Protect plant and equipment prior to painting.
Mix, match and blend paints to achieve desired colour, according to specification.
Apply paint to buildings, pipes and structures using rollers, brushes, airless and conventional spray methods.
Material handling to the work front and storage of completed items.
Removal of waste at the end of shift and maintain good housekeeping at all times.
Ensure all scheduled work is completed safely and at a high level of quality.
Report any safety or work related incidents immediately to Supervision.
Other duties as directed provided that such duties are within the training and ability.

We are seeking full-time radiographers who pride themselves on quality patient care and demonstrate a commitment to clinical quality, teamwork, and professional growth.

North Queensland X-ray Services is a Queensland owned company aiming to provide the community of Cairns and surrounds with quality imaging services whilst keeping out of pocket costs at a minimum by Bulk Billing the majority of the services provided.  We have various locations around the Cairns area with modalities offered including MRI, CT, Ultrasound, Interventional Procedures, Digital X-ray, BMD and OPG and Nuclear Medicine.

Key responsibilities include:

•	Performing Radiographic Examinations across our various locations in Cairns

•	Supportive and positive team culture
•	Opportunities for ongoing training along with continuing professional development

ICON enjoys a strong reputation for quality and is focused on staff development. We make it our mission to attract the most diverse and creative

minds into the business and we continually strive to provide opportunities for our people to excel, grow and build a great career. We understand that our greatest asset is the skills and talents of our people and they are truly what set us apart.

To learn more about ICON, please go to www.iconplc.com


CURRENT VACANCY:

Due to global growth and our recent partnership with global pharmaceutical companies, we are now recruiting for CRAII - Senior CRA. This role forms an integral part of an enthusiastic, inspirational, dynamic, friendly and supportive team.

Key Responsibilities:

- Working on a number of important studies in a variety of therapeutic areas involved in a range of clinical activities through to close out.
- Ensure that all activities are in compliance with SOP, ICH-GCP, local and global laws, regulations and guidelines
- Ensure all business is conducted professionally in compliance with company policies and procedures
- Liaise with internal and external parties, locally and globally

- Must have a Bachelor of Science, Pharmacy, Medicine, Nursing or related healthcare field
- CRA with 18 months+ experience
- Must have great interpersonal skills and be a good team player
- Strong communication and relationship building skills
